adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset to `false` inside the Cancel button handler. The `onSuccess` callback resets `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])` but does not clear `isInvalidEmail`, and closing via `Dialog`’s `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` likewise does not reset either `isInvalidEmail` or `multiEmailValue`. Nothing in `MultiEmail`’s `setValue` path clears `isInvalidEmail` either, so the error banner can persist after the user corrects input and across dialog reopenings (e.g., ESC/overlay close).
